sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好,这是6分钟英语 从英国广播公司学习英语。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Georgie. Georgie, what do you think makes a good citizen?
sentences.zh: 我是尼尔,我是乔治 乔治,你觉得什么是好公民?

sentences.en: Ooh, interesting question. I think a good citizen is someone who doesn't break the law and is generally kind to other people.
sentences.zh: 哦,有趣的问题。我认为一个好公民 是一个不违法的人, 并且一般对其他人是善良的。

sentences.en: What about you? Any ideas? Yeah, I agree.
sentences.zh: 那你呢 有主意吗 是的 我同意

sentences.en: But also maybe people who volunteer – so, people who run clubs for children and that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 但也许还有志愿者,所以,那些为儿童经营俱乐部的人,以及诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: I think they're good citizens. Now, being a citizen, a member of society who enjoys certain rights in return for having certain responsibilities, is an old idea that's been in the news a lot recently.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们是好公民。现在,作为一个公民,一个享有某些权利的社会成员, 以承担某些责任为回报, 是一个老思想,最近的新闻中有很多。

sentences.en: It's something that interests Myra Anubi, presenter of BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World.
sentences.zh: 英国广播公司世界服务节目《人民修复世界》的主持人Mira Anubi对此很感兴趣。

sentences.en: What do you think makes a good citizen? Is it someone who follows the laws of the land and pays their taxes?
sentences.zh: 你认为是什么使一个好公民?是那些遵守法律,纳税的人吗?

sentences.en: Well, some people might say it should go beyond that, and a good citizen is one who tries to improve the place where they live.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会说应该超越这一点, 一个好公民是试图改善他们生活的地方。

sentences.en: A good citizen obeys the law of the land – a term for the set of rules and laws that exists in a country.
sentences.zh: 一个好公民遵守国家的法律——这是一国存在的一套规则和法律的术语。

sentences.en: But should there be more to it than that?
sentences.zh: 但应该有比这更多的吗?

sentences.en: Around the world, young people today are less likely to vote, and many people aged 18 to 30 say they feel ignored by politicians.
sentences.zh: 在世界各地,今天的年轻人不太可能投票,许多18至30岁的人说他们感到被政客忽视。

sentences.en: So, in this programme, we'll be hearing about MyPolis, an exciting project helping young people in Portugal re-engage with their citizenship.
sentences.zh: 因此,在这个节目中,我们将听到MyPolis, 一个令人振奋的项目,帮助葡萄牙的年轻人重新获得公民身份。

sentences.en: And, as usual, we'll be learning some useful new words and phrases, all of which you'll find on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样,我们将学习一些有用的新词和新词, 所有这些都将在我们的网站上找到,bbclearingenglish.com。

sentences.en: But before that, I have a question for you, Neil.
sentences.zh: 但在此之前,我有一个问题要问你,尼尔。

sentences.en: The project's name, MyPolis, comes from the ancient Greek states, such as Athens and Sparta, where the idea of citizenship was born.
sentences.zh: 该项目的名称MyPolis来自古希腊州,如雅典和斯巴达,那里诞生了公民意识。

sentences.en: So, what is the meaning of the Ancient Greek word 'polis'?
sentences.zh: 古希腊语"polis"是什么意思?

sentences.en: Is it: a) vote, b) people, or c) city? Hmm, that's a good question.
sentences.zh: 是:a)投票,b)人民,或c)城市?嗯,这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: I'm going to guess b) people. OK. Well, I'll reveal the correct answer later in the programme.
sentences.zh: 好吧,我稍后会在节目中 揭示出正确的答案

sentences.en: MyPolis runs council assemblies where children can propose improvements to their local school community – anything from fixing broken water fountains to changing the curriculum.
sentences.zh: MyPolis管理议会会议, 孩子们可以提出改善当地学校社区的建议,

sentences.en: Local politicians also attend, listening to the children's ideas and responding by giving their support or explaining why not.
sentences.zh: 当地政治人物也出席,听取儿童的意见,并作出反应,给予支持或解释不这样做的原因。

sentences.en: The project was started by founder Bernardo Goncalves when he was in his 20s, because he was disappointed by interactions between political parties and young people.
sentences.zh: 该项目是20多岁的创始人Bernardo Goncalves发起的,因为他对政党与年轻人之间的互动感到失望。

sentences.en: Here's Bernardo telling more to BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World: We have seen a quick erosion in the trust of the population in the democratic institutions, such as the National Parliament, such as the government in office.
sentences.zh: 贝尔纳多向英国广播公司世界服务节目《改变世界:我们看到民众对民主机构的信任迅速削弱,

sentences.en: We need to find new ways to connect children and young citizens to democratic institutions, otherwise the gap will get bigger and bigger.
sentences.zh: 我们需要找到新的途径,将儿童和年轻公民与民主机构联系起来,否则差距将越来越大。

sentences.en: This is very dangerous for democracy. Bernardo thinks Portugal has seen an erosion of trust – a term for the gradual weakening of people's confidence in political and economic institutions, and the government in office.
sentences.zh: 这对民主来说是非常危险的。 贝尔纳多认为葡萄牙已经见证了信任的削弱 — — 这是一个逐渐削弱人民对政治和经济机构以及执政政府的信心的术语。

sentences.en: A government in office means the government in power at the present time.
sentences.zh: 现任政府是指目前执政的政府。

sentences.en: MyPolis mirrors the political activities that children will need as adult citizens – things like voting and holding politicians accountable.
sentences.zh: MyPolis反映了儿童作为成年公民需要的政治活动,比如投票和追究政治家的责任。

sentences.en: Reporter Alison Roberts visited schools around the Portuguese capital Lisbon and was impressed by what she saw, as she explains here to Myra Anubi, presenter of BBC World Service's People Fixing the World:
sentences.zh: 记者Alison Roberts访问葡萄牙首都里斯本附近的学校,

sentences.en: Another benefit is MyPolis has designed the programme so it can be included as part of the national curriculum, rather than as an Mmm.
sentences.zh: 另一个好处是,MyPolis设计了该方案,以便将其纳入国家课程,而不是作为Mmm。

sentences.en: Well, it's good to know that this is happening in other places, but the thing that also really strikes me here is that politicians are actually listening to these kids and taking them seriously, giving them answers, because politicians, as we know, can be hard to pin down.
sentences.zh: 很高兴知道这发生在其他地方, 但这里我也很惊讶的是, 政治家们实际上在认真对待这些孩子, 给他们答案, 因为我们知道,政治家们可能很难定下来。

sentences.en: The MyPolis programme is designed as part of the whole school curriculum and not just an add-on, meaning something extra that is added later, instead of being planned in from the start.
sentences.zh: " MyPolis " 方案是作为整个学校课程的一部分设计的,而不仅仅是一个附加内容,意思是后来增加的内容,而不是从一开始就计划。

sentences.en: Myra was impressed that local politicians take the school children seriously.
sentences.zh: Myra对当地政客认真对待学童印象深刻。

sentences.en: If you take someone or something seriously, youthink it's important and deserves attention.
sentences.zh: 如果你认真对待某人或某事, 你认为这是重要的,值得关注。

sentences.en: And that's good because, as everyone knows, politicians can be hard to pin down.
sentences.zh: 这很好,因为,大家都知道, 政治家们可能很难定下来。

sentences.en: To pin someone down means to force them to explain their plans and intentions in detail.
sentences.zh: 陷害某人意味着迫使他们详细解释他们的计划和意图。

sentences.en: It sounds like the programme is really developing active citizens of the future in Portugal.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像这个节目 真的发展活跃的公民 在葡萄牙的未来。

sentences.en: In fact, it's been so successful that similar programmes have been started in Italy, Hungary and Mozambique.
sentences.zh: 事实上,在意大利、匈牙利和莫桑比克也启动了类似的方案,这是非常成功的。

sentences.en: OK. Neil, I think I should reveal the answer to my question.
sentences.zh: 好吧,尼尔,我想我应该透露我的问题的答案

sentences.en: I asked you, "What is the meaning of the Ancient Greek word 'polis'?" And you said, "People," which was the wrong answer, I'm afraid.
sentences.zh: 我问你,"古希腊语"政治"是什么意思?" 你说,"人",我恐怕是错的答案。

sentences.en: The right answer was c) city. Argh, no! Right, it's time to recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with the law of the land – a term for the set of rules and laws that exists in a country.
sentences.zh: 正确的答案是(c) 城市。啊,不!现在是时候总结一下我们学到的词汇了,从土地法开始 — — 这是一个国家存在的一套规则和法律的术语。

sentences.en: An erosion of trust happens when people gradually lose confidence in political and economic institutions.
sentences.zh: 当人们逐渐丧失对政治和经济机构的信心时,信任就会受到损害。

sentences.en: If a government is in office, it means they are currently in power.
sentences.zh: 如果政府执政,这意味着他们现在掌权。

sentences.en: An add-on is an extra part that is added to something later, rather than being built in from the start.
sentences.zh: 附加部分是后来添加的部分,而不是从一开始就建立起来的部分。

sentences.en: If you take someone seriously, you consider them important and worthy of your attention.
sentences.zh: 如果你认真对待某个人 你就会认为他们很重要 值得你注意

sentences.en: And finally, if you find it hard to pin someone down, it's difficult to find out their specific plans and intentions.
sentences.zh: 最后,如果你觉得很难 确定一个人, 很难找到他们的具体计划和意图。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up but remember you'll find a quiz and worksheet for this episode over on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 再一次,我们的六分钟 到了,但记住,你会发现一个测验 和工作表 这个插曲在我们的网站,bbclearingenglish.com。

sentences.en: See you there soon. Bye! Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 回头见 再见
